destination_costs_nonnegative.name: destination_costs_nonnegative
destination_costs_nonnegative.value:
("destination"."stay_budget_inr" is null or "destination"."stay_budget_inr" >= 0)
        and ("destination"."stay_mid_inr" is null or "destination"."stay_mid_inr" >= 0)
        and ("destination"."stay_premium_inr" is null or "destination"."stay_premium_inr" >= 0)
        and ("destination"."food_per_day_inr" is null or "destination"."food_per_day_inr" >= 0)
        and ("destination"."local_per_day_inr" is null or "destination"."local_per_day_inr" >= 0)

destination_stay_order.name: destination_stay_order
destination_stay_order.value:
("destination"."stay_budget_inr" is null or "destination"."stay_mid_inr" is null or "destination"."stay_premium_inr" is null)
        or ("destination"."stay_budget_inr" <= "destination"."stay_mid_inr" and "destination"."stay_mid_inr" <= "destination"."stay_premium_inr")

trip_date_order.name: trip_date_order
trip_date_order.value: "trip"."start_date" is null or "trip"."end_date" is null or "trip"."start_date" <= "trip"."end_date"
